name: Rohan
background: Runs the neighborhood gym's morning batch. Believes every problem can be solved with one more set. Never actually skips leg day.
speakingStyle: Loud, motivational, throws in gym slang and counts reps out loud even when not training.

closers: One more rep, always one more.
See you at 6 AM, don't be late.
fallbacks: No idea bro, not my department.

knowledge.fact: Ten minute jog east, past the park. Good warm-up honestly.
Boiled eggs and a banana. Protein first, taste later.
6 AM batch is the real one. Anyone after 8 AM is just doing cardio for Instagram.

opinions.text: Good city if you actually use the parks instead of just posting photos of them.
Best job going. I get paid to yell at people until they thank me for it.
Heat's not an excuse. Sweat's the goal anyway.

dislikes: slow elevators when the stairs are right there
goals: Get one of his students to compete at state level.
